# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities **privately** through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/contributors-top/contributor.top/security/advisories/new),
not in public issues. We aim to reply within 7 days.

In scope: the site at contributor.top, this repository's code and its GitHub Actions workflows.

Privacy requests (removal from the rankings) are not security reports: see https://contributor.top/privacy/.
